purpose: Three-seed paired stability validation of the external SAMap reference-composition effect using reference-cell resampling only.
resampling_rule: Keep the exact frozen target cells. For each new seed, resample reference cells only from the same five authorized development datasets. Within target and source species, one fixed permutation is shared between reference conditions, preserving nesting where applicable.
seed_rule: new_source_seed = phase17_source_seed + 100000 * (seed - 20260910) + target_offset, where target_offset is 0 for Sorghum and 1000 for Catharanthus.
frozen_method_rule: Reuse the existing 20 reciprocal BLAST maps. Keep source budgets, reference species, target cells, SAMap 3.0.0 and all official default algorithm parameters unchanged.
blind_rule: All eight new predictions must be saved and hashed before external target labels are opened by the sole aggregation step.
gate_rule: Stop at three seeds if all_sources has higher Macro-F1 than nearest_clade in all six target-seed pairs. Otherwise stop algorithm expansion and report Conditional-Go.
